data.gender_notes: Mori is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Mori is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Mrituni', which means 'Goddess of death' or 'Goddess of the dead'. However, the name Mori is also associated with the Moon Goddess, Chandra, in Hindu mythology. The name is believed to bring grace, beauty, and calmness to the bearer. The name Mori carries the meaning “Moon Goddess” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mori usually hope their child will grow to embody moon goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
